title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Thin: one social post from a pregnant user recommends an RSV monoclonal antibody for infants under one, citing NT$16,000 per dose and a 32-36 week prenatal window; no product is named and RSV volume fell from 30 to 12 items.
products.implication: The post appears to blend infant antibody and prenatal dosing timing, suggesting parents may still be unclear on options and cost in the self-pay arena; there is no public-programme news this week.
products.action: Keep a label-consistent evidence pack on infant RSV immunisation timing ready for paediatric and obstetric stakeholders, and continue monitoring parent forums for cost and timing confusion.
products.signal_zh: 很少：一名孕婦在社群貼文推薦未滿一歲嬰兒使用RSV單株抗體，提及每劑NT$16,000及產前32-36週時間窗；未指名產品，RSV聲量由30則降至12則。
products.implication_zh: 該貼文似乎混淆了嬰兒抗體與產前接種時機，顯示家長對自費選項與費用可能仍不清楚；本週無公費相關新聞。
products.action_zh: 為兒科及婦產科利害關係人備妥符合仿單的嬰兒RSV免疫時機實證資料，並持續監測家長論壇對費用與時機的混淆。
who_zh: 婦產科醫師與產科診所

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, licensed 65+, in public programme for LTC residents
products.signal: Doctor-led articles in 三立, UDN and LINE TODAY link influenza to heart attack and stroke risk in people over 65 and discuss high-dose and adjuvanted vaccines; a veterans home began public vaccination including enhanced flu. High-dose volume fell from 14 to 9 items.
products.implication: Cardiovascular-risk framing by clinicians keeps enhanced vaccines in media, but product-adjacent consumer articles carry compliance sensitivity under Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules.
products.action: Support geriatric and cardiology stakeholders with balanced scientific evidence on influenza and cardiovascular outcomes, review any company-linked media engagement for compliance, and track enhanced-dose rollout in long-term care facilities.
who: Long-term care and veterans home operators
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，核准65歲以上，長照機構住民公費接種
products.signal_zh: 三立、聯合報及LINE TODAY的醫師主導文章將流感與65歲以上心肌梗塞及中風風險連結，並討論高劑量及佐劑型疫苗；一處榮家開始公費接種（含加強型流感疫苗）。高劑量聲量由14則降至9則。
products.implication_zh: 臨床醫師以心血管風險切入，使加強型疫苗維持媒體曝光，但涉及產品的消費者文章在台灣處方藥廣告規範下具法遵敏感性。
products.action_zh: 以平衡的科學實證支持老年醫學及心臟科利害關係人了解流感與心血管結果，審視任何與企業相關的媒體互動是否合規，並追蹤長照機構加強型疫苗推行情形。
who_zh: 老年醫學及心臟科醫師
長照機構及榮家經營者

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: No Tdap items this week, down from 7 the week before; nothing on policy, coverage or public conversation.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from the public conversation while flu and COVID-19 dominate, so there is no live issue but also low visibility.
products.action: Hold maternal and adult pertussis evidence and stakeholder contacts ready, and keep monitoring for pertussis case reports or programme changes.
who: Medical societies for chronic lung disease
products.signal_zh: 本週無Tdap相關則數，上週為7則；政策、接種率或公眾討論皆無。
products.implication_zh: 流感與COVID-19主導討論下，Tdap未見於公眾討論，雖無即時議題，但能見度也低。
products.action_zh: 備妥孕產婦及成人百日咳實證資料與利害關係人聯繫窗口，持續監測百日咳病例報告或計畫變動。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added a publicly funded Novavax COVID-19 option from October 19, said it plans additional Novavax doses, and repeated the option in its October 20 holiday call; several outlets explained that eligible people aged 12 and over can choose it.
products.implication: This is a public-programme (公費) launch in its first days, so attention will turn to site availability, dose allocation and eligibility clarity.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on dose distribution and site-level availability information, prepare factual eligibility Q&A for frontline clinics, and monitor for any brand-specific safety claims.
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起新增Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗選項，表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗，並在10月20日連假呼籲中重申此選項；多家媒體說明12歲以上符合資格者可選擇。
products.implication_zh: 此為公費上路初期，關注焦點將轉向接種點供應、劑量配置及資格說明是否清楚。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局協調疫苗配送及接種點供應資訊，為第一線診所準備資格Q&A，並監測任何針對品牌的安全性說法。

issues.title: Site-level availability questions for the new Novavax public option
issues.note: Taiwan CDC says more Novavax doses are planned; expect public and media questions about which clinics stock it as the option becomes known.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費新選項的接種點供應疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗；隨選項周知，預期民眾與媒體將詢問哪些診所有貨。

issues.title: Second-stage flu eligibility opens amid a severe H1N1 season
issues.note: With 44 weekly flu deaths and antivirals extended to November 15, scrutiny of programme reach and enhanced-vaccine coverage for older adults may rise.
issues.title_zh: H1N1嚴峻流行季中，流感疫苗第二階段開放
issues.note_zh: 單週44例流感死亡、抗病毒藥劑延長至11月15日，外界對計畫涵蓋程度及長者加強型疫苗覆蓋的檢視可能升高。

issues.title: Vaccine-ban style rumours spreading to other brands
issues.note: The Pentagon-ban rumour was quickly debunked by Taiwan CDC, and unverified COVID-19 safety posts are circulating, one with over 2,000 engagements; a brand-specific rumour template could recur.
issues.title_zh: 「疫苗禁用」類謠言擴及其他品牌
issues.note_zh: 國防部禁用謠言已遭疾管署迅速澄清，另有未經查證的COVID-19疫苗安全性貼文流傳，其中一則互動逾2,000次；針對特定品牌的謠言模式可能再現。

self_pay.title: Registration fees shape out-of-pocket cost of public shots
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports clinic registration fees of NT$150-200 for a public flu shot and asks where it is cheapest, showing price sensitivity even within the public programme.
self_pay.title_zh: 掛號費影響公費疫苗自付成本
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友表示公費流感疫苗診所掛號費NT$150-200，並詢問哪裡最便宜，顯示即使在公費範疇內也有價格敏感度。

self_pay.title: RSV infant antibody price cited at NT$16,000
self_pay.note: One post cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV antibody; this is a single social signal, not a verified price, and no clinic stock information appears.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則貼文提到嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000；此為單一社群訊號，非經查證價格，亦無診所庫存資訊。

self_pay.title: Little on self-pay enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: Doctor articles discuss adjuvanted and high-dose flu vaccines for over-65s but do not mention self-pay prices, stock or demand outside eligible groups, and nothing appears on Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費加強型流感疫苗或Tdap訊息極少
self_pay.note_zh: 醫師文章討論65歲以上適用的佐劑型及高劑量流感疫苗，但未提及自費價格、庫存或符合資格族群以外的需求，Tdap則無任何相關內容。
